subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs, generated i18n artifacts, and saved browser preferences?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable, but it changes shipped public IDs, documented setup inputs, generated artifacts, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the alias and migration policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime wiring, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region-code public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as public runtime and CLI IDs while continuing to accept script-form inputs as aliases where appropriate.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Use script-based naming only for docs or publishing metadata while keeping runtime and CLI locale IDs unchanged.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime wiring, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses public setup behavior, docs, compatibility policy, and current i18n file history where steipete is the strongest routing signal.
